themes_detail.label: Overgrown Trees & Branches Surge
themes_detail.summary: Complaints about overgrown tree branches and vegetation spiked to 14 THIS WEEK, a 239% increase over the 8-week baseline average of 4.1 weekly complaints, suggesting a sudden deterioration in street-level tree maintenance across Midwood.
evidence: 14 overgrown tree/branch complaints THIS WEEK vs. 4.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.6, high severity)
239% spike indicates acute acceleration, not baseline condition
Peak timing coincides with late spring growth season but exceeds historical seasonal norms
reporting_angles: Contact Parks Department to verify if tree maintenance crews are understaffed or behind schedule in CD 314
Interview residents about safety concerns: blocked sightlines, fallen branches, impact on sidewalk accessibility

themes_detail.label: Litter Basket Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Litter basket requests skyrocketed to 5 complaints THIS WEEK, a 300% spike from the 8-week baseline average of 1.2 weekly complaints, indicating residents are suddenly reporting missing or inadequate waste receptacles across the district.
evidence: 5 litter basket requests THIS WEEK vs. 1.2 weekly baseline average (z-score: 8.66, high severity)
300% increase suggests acute infrastructure gap, not gradual wear
Aligns with spring/summer season when foot traffic and outdoor activity increase
reporting_angles: Investigate whether recent budget cuts or staffing changes affected Sanitation Department basket maintenance/installation in this district
Identify which streets are generating complaints; map against high-traffic pedestrian corridors and commercial zones

themes_detail.label: Abandoned Bikes Multiplying
themes_detail.summary: Abandoned bike complaints jumped to 5 in the past week, a 900% surge from the 8-week average of 0.5 weekly complaints, pointing to either a new dumping problem or rapid accumulation of street clutter.
evidence: 5 abandoned bike complaints in past week vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 6.36, high severity)
900% spike is statistically extreme, suggests new or concentrated problem rather than ongoing baseline
Potential connection to nearby Coney Island Avenue and Nostrand Avenue rezoning activity drawing new residents
reporting_angles: Check with NYPD and Sanitation about whether there's a known chop-shop or dumping pattern in specific blocks
Interview residents: are these broken/unusable bikes, or evidence of bike theft/black market activity?

themes_detail.label: Heat & Hot Water Decline
themes_detail.summary: Heat/hot water complaints DROPPED 84% THIS WEEK to 38 complaints from the 8-week average of 243.2, a dramatic seasonal shift coinciding with warmer spring weather, but worth confirming this reflects genuine resolution rather than resident under-reporting.
evidence: 38 heat/hot water complaints THIS WEEK vs. 243.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: -3.76, high severity)
84% decrease is statistically significant but likely seasonal (warmer weather = less reliance on building heat)
Heat/hot water is top 2 complaint category overall (2,816 complaints over 90 days), suggesting chronic housing maintenance issues persist
reporting_angles: Verify with HPD whether the drop reflects fixed violations or just seasonal underreporting; track whether complaints resurge in fall
Investigate whether the 2,816 total heat/hot water complaints over 90 days have yielded actual building violations or DOE compliance orders

themes_detail.label: Elevator Complaints Escalate
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints surged to 30 two weeks ago, a 153% increase from the 8-week average of 11.9 weekly complaints, suggesting accelerating failures in older residential and commercial buildings across the district during a period of increased spring usage.
evidence: 30 elevator complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 11.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 3.5, high severity)
153% spike suggests either concentrated failures in specific buildings or aging elevator stock breaking down
Midwood has high density of older multifamily buildings; elevator maintenance often deferred in rent-stabilized units
reporting_angles: Cross-reference 311 elevator complaints against DOB violation records: which buildings are repeat offenders?
Interview residents in buildings with chronic elevator outages about impact on elderly, disabled, families with children
